climate: Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A small AVA in the northwestern part of Sonoma County, beside Lake Sonoma, with about 160 acres of vines at or above 800 feet. It overlaps the northwestern corner of the Dry Creek Valley appellation and sits within Northern Sonoma.
